description:
## Scope

Bring `pkix-difftest` to first-class shape: realistic corpora, real revocation coverage, and CI integration. Tracks the orphan diff-harness work that did not previously have an epic parent.

## Children (reparented)

- **PKIX-emf1** — CRL revocation in the differential harness (was orphan)
- **PKIX-g9vc** — x509-limbo corpus integration (Tier 2 for real) (was orphan)
- **PKIX-t0w4** — PKITS CertPath includes non-signing certs (path-building integration) (was orphan)
- **PKIX-klku** — diff harness CI integration (was orphan)
- **PKIX-5bab** — Tier-3 CT log scrape corpus (was orphan)

## Goal

After this epic closes:

- The differential harness exercises CRL revocation paths against OpenSSL and pyca/cryptography (not just chain validation).
- x509-limbo is a real Tier-2 corpus consumed by the harness (currently only PKITS is fully wired).
- PKITS path-building integration uses the full CertPath including non-signing certs (currently positional only).
- CI runs the differential harness on every push and reports divergences.
- Tier-3 (live CT log scrape) corpus is at least scaffolded so it can be extended later without re-architecture.

## Out of scope

- Adding new oracles beyond OpenSSL + pyca (no Bouncy Castle, no Go crypto/x509). File separately.
- Browser-equivalent path validation (rustls-webpki shape). The harness is RFC-conformance shaped.
notes:
Escalating to human (do-beads loop, 2026-05-11): this epic surfaces as ready because it has no direct dependencies, but it's a pure container. 5 of 6 children are closed; the remaining child PKIX-hbzo.1 (zlint + pkilint cross-validation oracles) is related-to PKIX-amgn.8 (zlint OSCAL catalog vendoring), which is itself open and a P2 human-decision item. PKIX-hbzo.1 only makes sense AFTER PKIX-amgn.8's vendored catalog exists (you can't cross-validate against a catalog that doesn't exist yet). So the epic is effectively human-blocked through that chain. Marking human-labeled so it stops appearing in autonomous ready queue. Reopen the autonomous path by either (a) advancing PKIX-amgn.8, (b) reparenting PKIX-hbzo.1 elsewhere, or (c) closing PKIX-hbzo.1 + closing the epic.
Dependency made explicit 2026-05-11 (Mark): PKIX-amgn.8 (vendor zlint catalog as OSCAL Catalog JSON) now blocks PKIX-hbzo.1 (zlint + pkilint cross-validation oracles) via a real blocks edge, replacing the informational relates-to link. Human label removed from this umbrella — the gating is now expressed in the dependency graph, not as a phantom "pending maintainer decision." When PKIX-amgn.8 closes, PKIX-hbzo.1 naturally unblocks; when .1 closes, this umbrella auto-closes as completed-molecule.
title: pkix-difftest: differential harness completeness (revocation, x509-limbo, CI, CT)
